items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I never met them, but I went into to hear Ray Miller.

ctx.x: You mentioned Bix. Was this the first time you saw Bix and Trumbauer?

No. When I was at school, I made a trip to New York one time. I never met them, but I went into to hear Ray Miller. I also, when I was at school I bought the records, the dance records, the phonograph records for the fraternity house that I was with and I used to like to listen to Trumbauer and then there was Miff was in the band, and it was very interesting to hear the choruses that they'd take and then they -- I went up one time to the Cinderella Ballroom and Bix is playing there with the Wolverines. I was…

can gather, he left the Wolverines because the Harman guys who told me about it, they played opposite the Wolverines in the Cinderella, and they told me that most of the time Jimmy McPartland had kind of taken his place for about five months or so, a six month engagement something like that.
